title: Direct hapten coated ELISA for immunosensing of low molecular weight analytes
protocol: Prepare fresh 47% (v/v) HNO3 in concentrated H2SO4 in a glass beaker in a fume hood.
Load 250 μl of acid in each well of microtiter plate and incubate for 30 min at room temperature under mild shaking to generate –NO2 groups on polystyrene surface.
Wash plate two times with DDW.
Prepare 5% aminopropyltriethoxy silane (APTES) solution in DDW (pH 6.9).
Load 250 μl of APTES solution in each well of microtiter plate and incubate for 2 h at room temperature to generate –NH2 groups on PS surface.
Wash plate two times with DDW.
Cure the microtiter plates at 62°C for 2 h to enhance the binding of APTES to the PS surface.
Mix 10 mg 2,4-D together with 1.7 mg (15 mmoles) NHS and 6.2 mg (30 mmoles) DCC in 1.3 ml DMF.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 4 h at RT.
Centrifuge the solution at 12000 RPM to remove the acyl urea precipitate.
Reconstitute the activated hapten solution in 0.05M carbonate buffer (pH9.6) to make the final concentration at 250 nmol/ml.
Add 100 μl of activated 2,4-D into each well of microtiter plate.
Incubate the plate overnight at 4°C.
Wash the plate three times with PBS.
Block unbound sites of PS surface with 0.2 M formaldehyde in PBS by incubating plates for 2 h at 37°C.
Wash the plate four times thoroughly with PBS.
Add 100 μl per well anti-2,4-D antibody solution prepared in PBSM at 0.1 mg/ml concentration.
Incubate the plate for 2 h at 37°C.
Wash the plate five times with PBS.
Load 100 μl per well secondary antibody (goat anti-rabbit IgG-HRP) at 1:5000 dilution made in PBSM.
Incubate the plate for 1 h at 37°C.
Wash the plate six times with PBS.
Add 100 μl per well TMB substrate for color development.
Stop the reaction after 30 minutes by adding 50 μl per well 1N H2SO4.
Measure the absorbance at 450 nm with ELISA reader.
Prepare hapten coated plates as described in steps (1-16).
Pre-mix anti-2,4-D antibody (0.1 mg/ml) with different concentrations of free hapten (0.5 pg/ml to 5 μg/ml) in PBSM for 30 minutes.
Add 100 μl of pre-incubated mixture in each well.
Incubate the plate for 2 h at 37°C.
Wash the plate five times with PBS.
Load 100 μl of goat anti-rabbit IgG-HRP (1:5000 dilution) prepared in PBSM into each well.
Incubate the plate for 1 hour at 37°C.
Wash the plate six times with PBS.
Add 100 μl per well TMB substrate for color development.
Stop the reaction after 30 minutes by adding 50 μl per well of 1N H2SO4.
Measure the absorbance at 450 nm using an ELISA reader.
